name: Miscegenation Intermarriage
overview: Scripture warns against miscegenation intermarriage primarily because it leads God's people away from faithful worship, as foreign wives cause their husbands to serve other gods (Exodus 34:16; Deuteronomy 7:4). The historical record in Joshua and Judges shows that such unions resulted in spiritual compromise and judgment, with foreign nations becoming snares that brought destruction and idolatry upon Israel (Joshua 23:12-13; Judges 3:6-7). These passages emphasize the serious consequences of intermarriage with ungodly nations, highlighting the need for separation to maintain covenant faithfulness.
